text:
cam: Quick sync 1: assembling the changelog bullets for the Friday deploy. Need final wording for: SDKv2 snippet changes, Dedicated->Private migration note, and a short known-issues blurb.
anya: I can draft the blurb for the migration note. Key change: config `network_mode` -> `network_profile`. Also want a short command example.
talia: I'm finishing the Node snippet updates. Switching to `const client = new RedwoodClientV2({ apiKey })` and the streaming API now uses `client.stream(...)`.
cam: Good catch, Talia. Make the snippet show error handling too. Keep it minimal (2-3 lines).
raj: Found two anchor regressions after yesterday's refactor: `/docs/private/config#auth` and `/docs/dedicated/limits#batching`. I'll open a redirect PR.
docs-bot: link-checker: 2 broken links detected -> created ticket #812. CI preview blocked until redirects merged.
anya: Raj please add redirects and a short note in the migration guide: "if you see 404s for old anchors, follow redirects or search for `network_profile`". Also add a tiny curl example for changing config: 

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/configs/123 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"network_profile":"vpc-optim"}'
```

talia: Node snippet I'm planning: 

```js
const client = new RedwoodClientV2({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
for await (const chunk of client.stream('gpt-open-7b', { prompt: 'TL;DR' })) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.text)
}
```

I'll include a short comment about token accounting differences between models.
cam: Nice. Add a one-line note under the changelog: "SDK: migration to RedwoodClientV2 (streaming API update). See migration guide." Keep it under 80 chars.
sophia: Heads-up: product asked to avoid the term "deprecation" in public changelog for the older embeddings endpoint, they prefer "superseded". Also want a short 'how to migrate' link.
anya: We'll use "superseded" then. Add a tiny migration step in Known Issues: demonstrate curl to call the new endpoint and show param rename: `model_id` -> `model`.
raj: Redirect PR opened: #429. I included both anchors and a note in the redirect page. Requesting review from @anya.
docs-bot: deploy-preview started for branch docs/migrate-snippets-2026.
cam: Can someone run `make docs-build` locally and sanity-check the code blocks? I want to avoid markdown escaping issues.
talia: Running now. Also added a small unit test to ensure the snippet renders in the site (docs/snippets/test_node_stream.test.md).
docs-bot: deploy-preview: failed  error: missing closing backticks in docs/migration/config.md line 72.
cam: Oof. I'll push a fix for the mismatched fenced block.
cam: Fixed and force-pushed.
docs-bot: deploy-preview: success  preview URL: https://deploy-preview-151.docs.redwood.ai
anya: Great. Merge plan: wait for one more review on #429 then merge all PRs, run link-checker, then schedule the changelog post. I'll draft the release note bullets and ping marketing.
sophia: Draft received. Suggested tweak: change "SDKv2" to "SDK v2" in the public copy.
cam: Done. Final checklist: snippets updated (Node + Python), redirects in, known-issues repro + curl examples, changelog bullet <80 chars and uses "superseded". I'll post the release digest on Friday morning.
anya: Thanks all :rocket:
